Analysis.object: Several factors identified in this study (e.g., athlete status, perfectionism) appear to play a role in the development of ED in this population. The study of other factors such as athletic identity and the coach-athlete relationship could provide insight into the development of ED symptoms within this group of athletes.

The study uses self-reported data; cross sectional design of the study. Athletes who were neither studying not employed exhibited more drive for thinness attitudes and behaviors than did those who were studying and/or employed yet few participants were in this situation. The uniquely Francophone sample may also a limitation.

Future studies could assess whether offering athletes mental health training in their sporting environment could help reduce their ED symptoms. The development of knowledge concerning the mechanisms underlying the drive for muscularity and thinness could be the subject of future quantitative studies, providing a deeper understanding of the risk factors associated with ED.
